name: Aryan Brotherhood of North Carolina
description: The Aryan Brotherhood of North Carolina is a white supremacist prison gang operating primarily within North Carolina's correctional system. Despite sharing a name with the original Aryan Brotherhood, it has no documented organizational connection to that California-based gang or its Texas counterpart. It is considered a regional, independently structured group.
